name: keske
description: Keşke: what a Turkish lira amount, paid monthly or once from a past month, would be worth today in gold, US dollars, euros, BIST 100, government bonds or a TL deposit, after inflation. From TÜİK's monthly return data; shows a chart card. Past results only, not investment advice.

interface.longDescription:
Keşke shows what Turkish lira put into gold, US dollars, euros, the BIST 100, bonds or a TL deposit would be worth today, after inflation, from TÜİK data.

Keşke ("if only" in Turkish) answers a question many savers in Türkiye ask: "If I had put that money into gold, dollars or the stock market back then, what would it be worth today, after inflation?"

Tell ChatGPT an amount in Turkish lira, every month or once, and a start month, for example "If I had put 5,000 TL a month into gold since January 2020, what would it be worth today?" Keşke calculates the result for gold bullion, the US dollar, the euro, the BIST 100 index, Turkish government bonds (DİBS) and TL deposits, and shows it in a card:

- what the payments would be worth now, for each asset;
- the gain or loss after inflation (real return), measured against the same payments restated in today's lira with consumer inflation (CPI);
- the same money kept as TL cash, and how much buying power it lost;
- each asset month by month on one scale.

In the card you can change the amount, the months, monthly or once, and whether the amount rises with inflation. Keşke also shows each asset's return before and after inflation over any period, such as the last 12 months or a calendar year, and what a lira amount from a past month is worth in today's money.

Data: TÜİK's monthly bulletin of real rates of return of financial investment instruments (Kaynak: TÜİK), from January 1997 to the latest published month; government bonds from January 2005. New months arrive on their own after TÜİK publishes them.

Limits:
- Historical, hypothetical results only. Keşke is not investment advice: it never recommends an asset and makes no forecasts.
- Each payment buys at its month's average level and is valued at the last month's average. Deposits are gross (before withholding tax), BIST 100 excludes dividends, and no fees, spreads or taxes are applied.
- Turkish lira and these six assets only; no live quotes, single stocks or funds.
- No accounts, and your calculations are not stored.
- In Turkish and English, following the language you write in. Not affiliated with TÜİK or Borsa İstanbul.
defaultPrompt: Keşke: 2020'den beri her ay 5.000 TL altın alsaydım bugün ne ederdi?
Keşke: what would 100,000 TL put into US dollars in 2018 be worth today?
Keşke: son 12 ayda altın, dolar, borsa ve mevduatın reel getirisi

positive.description: A monthly what-if across all six assets, in Turkish. Run in a new chat. There is nothing to sign in to. The card and the reply follow the language of the prompt, so they are in Turkish even when ChatGPT's language is English. Figures use the latest month TÜİK has published (September 2026 at submission); after TÜİK's next release the values move by a month. ChatGPT may open the card in a side panel instead of in the chat, and sometimes calls the tool twice; every card shows the same figures.
positive.prompt: Keşke ile hesapla: Ocak 2020'den beri her ay 5.000 TL yatırsaydım altın, dolar, euro, borsa, DİBS ve mevduatta bugün ne ederdi?
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows 'Oca 2020 – Eyl 2026 · her ay 5.000 TL', paid in 405.000 TL (81 payments) and 1.726.600 TL in September 2026 lira, and one bar per asset plus TL cash, highest first: gold 2.849.218 TL (reel +%65,0) and BIST 100 above the inflation line in blue, the euro, the dollar, the deposit and DİBS below it in red, TL cash 405.000 TL (reel −%76,5). The reply repeats these figures in a sentence or two, names the source ('Kaynak: TÜİK') and says it is not investment advice. It recommends no asset and makes no forecast.

positive.description: A one-time amount in English. Run in a new chat or after case 1. ChatGPT may pass only the US dollar (the card then shows the dollar and TL cash) or all six assets; both pass.
positive.prompt: With Keşke: what would 100,000 TL put into US dollars in January 2018 be worth today, after inflation?
positive.expected_behavior: The card, in English like the prompt, shows 'Jan 2018 · 100,000 TL once' and the US dollar at 1,287,919 TL (−2.4% after inflation; the 100,000 TL is 1,319,554 TL in September 2026 lira), next to the same 100,000 TL kept as TL cash (−92.4%). The reply gives the dollar figure, what the 100,000 TL is in today's lira, the real return, the source (TÜİK) and that it is not investment advice.

positive.description: Returns over a period. Run after case 1 or on its own. The deposit row compounds TÜİK's monthly deposit returns (a deposit renewed every month): +43,4% nominal for these 12 months, where the annual deposit column of TÜİK's bulletin prints 30,15%. The reply and the card's notes say 'her ay yenilenen' (renewed monthly); the other five assets match the bulletin's annual figures.
positive.prompt: Keşke ile göster: son 12 ayda altın, dolar, euro, borsa, DİBS ve mevduatın reel getirisi ne oldu?
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the period 'Eki 2025 – Eyl 2026', the rise in consumer prices (+%29,7) and one bar per asset around zero: blue above inflation, red below, each with its real and nominal return (deposit renewed monthly +%10,6 real, gold +%5,3, DİBS +%3,9; BIST 100 −%4,6, dollar −%9,2, euro −%11,0). The reply lists the six returns and the inflation figure, names the source and says it is not investment advice; it does not say which asset to buy.

positive.description: Raising the amount with inflation, then changing it in the card. Run after case 1. In the card, tap 'Değiştir' (Change), type 2000 as the amount, pick 'Bir kez' (Once) and tap 'Hesapla' (Calculate). Taps in the card bring no approval prompt.
positive.prompt: Keşke ile hesapla: 2015'ten beri her ay bugünün parasıyla 3.000 TL biriktirseydim, tutarı enflasyona göre artırarak, BIST 100'de ve altında ne olurdu?
positive.expected_behavior: The card's line reads 'her ay 3.000 TL · enflasyona göre artarak', and the payments in September 2026 lira come to 3.000 TL × 141 months = 423.000 TL. After the change in the card, the card recalculates in place: 'Oca 2015 · bir kez 2.000 TL' (2.000 TL of January 2015 is 34.860 TL in September 2026 lira) with new bars; the raise-with-inflation box applies to monthly payments only, so it is hidden for 'Bir kez'. ChatGPT is told about the new result, so asking 'What did that show?' afterwards gets the new figures.

positive.description: What an old amount is worth in today's lira. Run in any chat.
positive.prompt: Keşke ile hesapla: Ocak 2010'daki 1.000 TL bugünün parasıyla kaç TL eder?
positive.expected_behavior: The reply says the 1.000 TL of January 2010 is 25.080 TL in September 2026 lira and that kept as cash it lost 96,0% of its buying power (reel −%96,0). Keşke answers this with a one-time what-if, so the reply and the card also list what the 1.000 TL would have become in the asset or assets ChatGPT passed (all six if it passed none; gold 127.343 TL, reel +%407,7). Source: TÜİK; not investment advice.

negative.description: Advice about what to buy now. Keşke only reports the past and never recommends or predicts; ChatGPT answers itself.
negative.prompt: Should I buy gold or dollars this month?
negative.expected_behavior: No Keşke tool is called. ChatGPT answers in general terms without a personal recommendation from Keşke.

negative.description: A live quote. Keşke has monthly averages from TÜİK, no live exchange rates.
negative.prompt: What is the US dollar to Turkish lira exchange rate right now?
negative.expected_behavior: No Keşke tool is called. ChatGPT answers with its own search or says it can't see live rates.

negative.description: An unrelated calculation. Keşke does what-ifs on six assets, not loans.
negative.prompt: Calculate the monthly payment on a 2,000,000 TL home loan at 3% interest a month over 10 years.
negative.expected_behavior: No Keşke tool is called. ChatGPT calculates the loan payment itself.

publication.release_notes: Clearer listing and tool text for questions asked in Turkish. The calculate_what_if and show_real_returns descriptions and the server instructions now name the ways people ask ('keşke … alsaydım', '2015'teki 10.000 TL bugün kaç TL', 'geçen ay hangi yatırım aracı ne kazandırdı'); the listing gains Turkish and English search words, a new Turkish subtitle and a what-if skill. Tool names, inputs, results and the card are unchanged.

tr-TR.subtitle: Altın, dolar, borsa, enflasyon
tr-TR.description:
Keşke, Türkiye'de birikim yapan birçok kişinin sorduğu bir soruyu cevaplar: "O parayı o zaman altına, dolara ya da borsaya yatırsaydım bugün enflasyondan arındırılmış olarak ne ederdi?"

ChatGPT'ye bir TL tutar (her ay ya da bir kez) ve bir başlangıç ayı söyle; örneğin "Ocak 2020'den beri her ay 5.000 TL altına yatırsaydım bugün ne ederdi?" Keşke sonucu külçe altın, ABD doları, euro, BIST 100 endeksi, devlet iç borçlanma senetleri (DİBS) ve TL mevduat için hesaplar ve bir kartta gösterir:

- ödemelerin her varlıkta bugün ne edeceği;
- enflasyondan arındırılmış (reel) kazanç ya da kayıp: aynı ödemeler TÜFE ile bugünün parasına çevrilerek karşılaştırılır;
- aynı paranın yastık altında TL olarak tutulması ve kaybettiği alım gücü;
- her varlığın aydan aya seyri, aynı ölçekte.

Kartta tutarı, ayları, her ay ya da bir kez seçeneğini ve tutarın enflasyona göre artırılmasını değiştirebilirsin. Keşke ayrıca her varlığın son 12 ay ya da bir takvim yılı gibi bir dönemdeki nominal ve reel getirisini ve geçmişteki bir TL tutarının bugünkü karşılığını gösterir.

Veri: TÜİK'in aylık Finansal Yatırım Araçlarının Reel Getiri Oranları bülteni (Kaynak: TÜİK), Ocak 1997'den yayımlanan son aya kadar; DİBS Ocak 2005'ten beri. TÜİK yeni ayı yayımladıktan sonra kendiliğinden eklenir.

Sınırlar:
- Yalnızca geçmişe dönük, varsayımsal sonuçlar; yatırım tavsiyesi değildir. Keşke hiçbir varlığı önermez ve tahmin yapmaz.
- Her ödeme kendi ayının ortalamasından alınır, son ayın ortalamasıyla değerlenir. Mevduat brüttür (stopaj düşülmemiştir), BIST 100'e temettü dahil değildir; komisyon, makas ve vergi yoktur.
- Yalnızca TL ve bu altı varlık; anlık kur, tek tek hisseler ya da fonlar yok.
- Hesap yok; hesaplamaların saklanmaz.
- Türkçe ve İngilizce; yazdığın dili izler. TÜİK ya da Borsa İstanbul ile bağlantılı değildir.
